text: • Wound flushed wih saline and inspected for internal damage: muscle (Torn) observed.
• Wound flushed with DCA & Saline.
• A sterile C-hook was threaded with catgut and utilized to suture the muscle. Held well.
• Wound flushed wih saline and inspected for internal damage: muscle (Severed) observed.
• Wound flushed with DCA & Saline.
• A sterile scalpel was utilized to trim the damaged muscle tissue.
• A sterile C-hook was threaded with silk and utilized to suture the muscle. Held well.
• Severity of the damage to the vein was assessed and observed to be nicked.
• Wound flushed thoroughly with Saline.
• A sterile C-hook was threaded with silk and utilized to suture the vein with an interrupted looping stitch. Held well.
• Hemostats were removed, distally and then proximally, and vein checked for leakage: none present.
• Wound flushed with DCA & Saline.
• Severity of the damage to the vein was assessed and observed to be severed/jagged.
• A sterile scalpel was utilized in order to trim the slanted edged of the vein.
• Wound flushed thoroughly with Saline.
• A sterile C-hook was threaded with silk and utilized to suture the vein with an interrupted looping stitch. Held well.
• Hemostats were removed, distally and then proximally, and vein checked for leakage: none present.
• Wound flushed with DCA & Saline.
• Severity of the damage to the artery was assessed and observed to be nicked.
• Wound flushed thoroughly with Saline.
• A sterile C-hook was threaded with silk and utilized to suture the artery with an interrupted looping stitch. Held well.
• Hemostats were removed, distally and then proximally, and artery checked for leakage: none present.
• Wound flushed with DCA & Saline.
• Severity of the damage to the artery was assessed and observed to be severed/jagged.
• A sterile scalpel was utilized in order to trim the slanted edged of the artery.
• Wound flushed thoroughly with Saline.
• A sterile C-hook was threaded with silk and utilized to suture the artery with an interrupted looping stitch. Held well.
• Hemostats were removed, distally and then proximally, and artery checked for leakage: none present.
• Wound flushed with DCA & Saline.
